name: carbon-lite
description: Carbon Core is an open-source AI testing agent for software testing, quality checks, accessibility testing, regression testing and bug finding. Jay plans risk-based tests and produces evidence-backed quality reports inside your coding agent.

interface.longDescription:
Carbon Core is an open-source AI testing agent for software testing and quality checks inside your coding agent. Jay, your AI test manager, helps developers and QA engineers plan risk-based tests, test user journeys, find reproducible bugs, investigate accessibility and create evidence-backed quality reports.

Start with /carbon for a risk-based assessment or /full for a comprehensive, resumable testing workflow using the included capabilities. Use /carbon-test for feature testing and browser testing with authorized host tools; /carbon-issues for bug finding; /carbon-accessibility for accessibility testing; and /carbon-map to explore test evidence and coverage gaps. Jay can help create regression tests using your project's test framework. Try the bundled TestBucks demo or talk to Jay with /jay or /j.

Review test plans, findings, test results and confidence assessments in visual HTML reports. Executed checks remain distinct from proposed work; confidence reflects available evidence, not a correctness guarantee. Coverage depends on project context, access and available tools.

Uses the host's authorized browser and terminal tools and configured model access. No separate CARBON model key, MCP server, OAuth or hosted account is required. Model usage remains subject to the host provider’s terms. Local evidence stays in your workspace; your coding agent may send context to its model provider. Optional command-usage analytics is off by default. Distributed under the MIT license.
